prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in Baytown, Texas, and has back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1089; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision at the intersection in Baytown. Can you confirm you're comfortable continuing on the recording?

A: Yes, that's fine.

Q: Please describe in your own words how the collision happened.

A: I was driving through the intersection on a green light. I was going at a normal speed, maybe thirty-five. A pickup coming from my right didn't stop and hit the driver's side of my car.

Q: Did you see the pickup before the impact?

A: Not really. I glanced to my right and saw something moving, but there wasn't time to react.

Q: Were there any traffic signals or signs that you noticed at the time?

A: My light was green. I'm pretty sure of that because I had just come from the light behind me and it had been green for a while.

Q: Were you injured in the collision?

A: My lower back hurts. It tightened up right away, and by the next morning it was pretty stiff. I went to urgent care and they said it was a strain.

Q: Have you received any treatment since then?

A: I've been doing physical therapy twice a week and taking muscle relaxers when it gets bad. I still can't lift anything heavy without pain.

Q: Did you have any pain or problems with your back before this collision?

A: No, not that I can think of. I've had a little soreness after long workdays, but nothing I had to see a doctor about.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?

A: Just that I was following the rules and I want to get my car repaired and my back taken care of.

Q: Thank you. That concludes the statement.
